newsitem.title: USA: Fieldcrest to sell assets of division.
newsitem.headline: Fieldcrest to sell assets of division.

text.p: Fieldcrest Cannon Inc said Friday that it has agreed to sell certain inventories and equipment of its blanket division to Pillowtex Corp for about $30 million cash.
In a release Friday, Fieldcrest said that the sale would result in the closing of the blanket division facilities in Eden, N.C., cutting about 750 jobs.
Fieldcrest said that after providing for employee termination benefits and facility disposal costs, it expects a pretax charge of about $4.5 million in the third quarter of 1996.
The company said that net income will be reduced by $2.8 million, or $0.31 a share.
The transaction is expected to take place by the end of 1996, Fieldcrest added.
